item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base a3cf73e67; three commits, +579/-4 across nine files -- the production change threads session and lift_id onto the pace row, reads the session off the row in the bookend refusal, passes session and clocks in dispatch_sessions, and teaches pace_replay to read session and lift_id as nullable known keys rather than damage.
item_verdicts.done_when: the gate tests/test_a_lift_reaches_every_budget_row.py drives every clause against a synthesised project and a temporary RECKON_HOME -- a no-lift row records its session and lift_id None and the configured multiple; a session lift marks its own row and not another's; the bookend refusal admits the lifting session and refuses another; _pace_readings hands the row clocks as one reading; a moved seven-day reset ends the lift on routing's path while another session's read does not; another session's preflight names session_lift without applying it; replay reads the multiple the row recorded. 7 passed EXIT=0 reproduced here.
item_verdicts.goal: Every budget reader a dispatch reaches outside reckon/crew/dispatch.py now takes the dispatching session and the pace clocks -- budget.pace_row accepts session (reckon/budget.py:3193) and passes it to group_pace, records session and lift_id on the row (reckon/budget.py:3247,3252), group_pace reports another session's lift under session_lift without applying it (reckon/budget.py:2870), dispatch_admission reads the session back off the pace record (reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:327), and dispatch_sessions threads session and the row's clocks into _budget_verdict (reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1058,1467); reproduced at head.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete; commits df9bd5579, 9d69c3c72, 1ed17e138; baseline_suite (a3cf73e67, 138 passed, failure_count 0) and after_suite (9d69c3c72, 145 passed, failure_count 0) both readable and complete; negative_control_log names logs/negative-control.log whose first line repeats the mutation and whose last line is EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff touches reckon/budget.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py, reckon/crew/pace_replay.py, three test modules, the evidence fragment and the figure -- all inside the declared scope, the last three added when a resume widened the grant; routing.py was declared and not edited because no change was needed; no plan-version or plan-modified meta line moves.

justifications.durability: the declared mutation (budget.pace_row passing session None to group_pace) reddens two cases in tests/test_a_lift_reaches_every_budget_row.py as recorded and re-read in logs/negative-control.log (2 failed, 5 passed, EXIT=1), and the added assertions compare against independent expected constants (LIFT_MULTIPLE 1.8, MULTIPLE 1.1) rather than against the value the code was handed.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's own arms read base a3cf73e67 138 passed EXIT=0 and head 9d69c3c72 145 passed EXIT=0 with zero failures on both, and I independently reproduced the node module at head 1ed17e138 (7 passed EXIT=0, logs/review-node-module.log); docked because baseline_suite lists nine modules and after_suite ten, the node's new module having no base counterpart, so zero-added is partly by construction.
justifications.fit: the new helpers are named by mechanism (reckon/budget.py:2874 _other_session_lift, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:54 _pace_readings), the docstrings state the mechanism, no plan, sprint or ticket identifier and no version suffix appears in the changed source or the three commit subjects, and each commit carries a subject with a body and no AI attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the session rides budget.pace_row (reckon/budget.py:3247) and group_pace records another session's lift without applying it (reckon/budget.py:2870), and the row's lift_id and lifted multiple are recorded (reckon/budget.py:3352,3355); docked one because the real dispatch call site at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:972 does not yet pass the session, so a production row still carries session None until the next node lands.
justifications.reuse: _other_session_lift extends the existing lift owner by calling budget_lift.list_lifts and budget_lift.effective_budget (reckon/budget.py:2889) rather than re-deriving lift resolution, and _pace_readings reuses the row's own clocks rather than taking a fresh reading.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff a3cf73e67..1ed17e138 --name-only lists exactly the declared files plus the three added by the resume's scope widening (reckon/crew/pace_replay.py, tests/test_dispatch_records_the_pace_row.py, tests/test_pace_replay.py), with no plan, ledger or index path touched.
